intent: Backs tpunit++'s ASSERT_EQUAL/ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL family, printing both compared values with an = or != between them when an assertion fails.

objects.name: PrintEquality
objects.role: constructor-only helper templated on the two compared types; prints 'a (= or !=) b' to cout when constructed

objects.name: operator<<(ostream&, const map<T,U>&)
objects.role: prints a map as one 'k: v' line per entry

misfits.why: Generic stream-formatting utilities with no dependency on PrintEquality or tpunit, bundled here only because PrintEquality's own printing happens to need them
misfits.suggested_home: a shared stream-formatting utility header in libstuff, or null

name_fit.note: The file does far more than print equality - it defines general-purpose container-printing operators.

location_fit.note: Test-only placement is defensible for the class itself, less so for the generic operator<< overloads it carries.

naming_quality.note: PrintEquality's own name matches its narrow job.
